title: docs(changeset): date the three named-view census entries that PR objectui#10884 made false (objectui#10885, member 3)
body:
Part of #10885
Clause-②: no

Member 3 of objectui#10885: release-text corrections in `.changeset/` only. objectui#10885 remains open for member 4 (route 2 reading `fieldOrder`, `label`, `data`, `navigation` and `inlineEdit` off the active named view), which is a later dispatch.

## What changed

Three pending changesets each get one dated note. The form is the objectui#10533 one: the `⚠️ **Dated note, …**` blocks in `.changeset/6235-mergedsort-wrap.md`, `10156-edit-form-writes-only-changed-fields.md`, `10167-formpage-file-field-arm.md` and `7189-grouped-grid-partial-disclosure.md`. Each note has a bold headline with the date and the cards whose changes supersede the sentence, then what holds now, then the superseding entries by file and PR, and ends with "the text above is kept as the reading of this change".

- Zero lines deleted. `git diff --numstat` against the base `5c94589f0` gives 19, 15 and 23 insertions and 0 deletions.
- The frontmatter is byte-identical. The md5 of each frontmatter block is the same at the base and the head:
  - census, buckets and 7947 `2ee28f1e1b449ccc2dd97fdcc6c2bc1f` (each an empty `---` / `---` pair);
  - 7779 `ecedb10c5189b2c8841ea736b67c3cc6`.
- Placement: each note sits directly after the last paragraph that holds a false sentence. Where the false paragraphs are adjacent, one note covers them. This is the PR objectui#10891 placement rule.

| Entry | Sentence false for the release (quoted) | What the note states | Moved by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `7924-named-list-view-liveness-census.md` | "so the partition is 21 read and 43 unread of 64 today" | 43 read and 21 unread of 64 at the note's date (20 read / 44 unread in between) | objectui#7928 (PR objectui#10821) stopped reading a named view's `options` bag, then objectui#10758 (PR objectui#10884) read the twenty-three bucket-① members off the named view |
| same entry, next paragraph | "the disposition for the unread members (`?: never` tombstones vs. making the renderer read them) stays with objectui#7928" | the 2026-09-16 director-seat ruling on objectui#7924 decided it, and both halves landed in this release: the tombstones of `7924-named-list-view-retire.md` and the reads of objectui#10758 | objectui#7924 (PR objectui#10285) and objectui#10758 (PR objectui#10884) |
| `7924-named-list-view-disposition-buckets.md` | "the **43** unread members partition **23 + 8 + 10 + 2**" and "the disposition for the 43 unread members" | 21 unread, partitioned 0 + 8 + 11 + 2 at the note's date (44 = 23 + 8 + 11 + 2 in between) | objectui#7928 (PR objectui#10821): `options` joins the objectui-only bucket; then objectui#10758 (PR objectui#10884): the first bucket's 23 are read |
| `7947-named-list-view-figures.md` (patch round 1) | "The declaration has **47** top-level members"; "gives 59 on the same declaration"; "The derived "unread" figure is **41**"; "the renderer reads seven keys off a named view, but only six of them … are declared members"; "The seventh, `data`, is not declared on `NamedListView` at all"; "the arithmetic is 47 − 6"; "It is now an exact `toBe(47)`" | at the note's date: the TypeScript parser and the strict regex both count 64 declared members and the loose regex counts 76; the renderer reads 43 of them off a named view, every one declared, and `options` is not among them; 64 − 43 = 21 unread; the pin is an exact `toBe(64)` | objectui#8980 (PR objectui#9534): 64 members, `data` declared and its `as any` cast removed; objectui#7928 (PR objectui#10821) and objectui#10758 (PR objectui#10884): the read / unread split |

The 7947 note covers both false paragraphs, the figures paragraph and the pin paragraph. It sits after the pin paragraph, before "No schema, no type, and no assertion about what is accepted or refused changed.", which is true of that change and is left alone.

**Sentences judged true for the release and left alone:**
- The census entry:
  - the TypeScript-parser walk;
  - the read set "derived through every route from `schema.listViews`", with every occurrence classified;
  - "pinned by name on its side of the partition";
  - "6 read, 41 unread of 47 when this entry was written" (dated in its own words);
  - "neither declaration face moved" and "Test only" (this change's own delta).
- The buckets entry:
  - the protocol declares 50 keys, 5 of them tombstones, and objectui declares all 45 live keys (the census pins below pass);
  - the zod 4 `.omit().extend().superRefine()` refusal;
  - "stays where the ruling put it";
  - "Test only".
- The 7947 entry:
  - "Corrective, comment-and-figures only";
  - "quoted wrong in four places" and the "about 52" history;
  - the `namedListViewMemberCount()` regex, which is still in the pin file and is asserted equal to the parser's count;
  - "Corrected at all four sites" (the sibling is still unconsumed);
  - the `toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(40)` history;
  - "whose failure message names the three sibling files";
  - the final "No schema, no type" sentence.

Each note states its figures dated "at this note's date" and names the pin that re-derives them, `object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.test.ts`. The figures are therefore not written down as live readings (AGENTS.md commandment #9).

## Deviation from the dispatch, ruled A by the seat

`.changeset/object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.md` is left byte-identical. Its whole-file md5 is `e6871b2c128737ee66b94ee8d0ecd07d` at the base and at the head.
- Every phrase the dispatch quotes from it already carries a dated note on `main`: "renderer reads **21** off a named view", "**43 unread members**" and "`listViews` stays unmirrored".
- That note is PR objectui#10891 (objectui#10877, `733fd5ac65`). After that PR's patch round 2, it says "the split is no longer the 21 and 43 this entry counted", names objectui#7928 and objectui#10758 as the movers, and cites the census pin.
- A second note would reverse that seat's recorded choice (REWORK `5864543090`).

## The census on `main`, measured

At the base `5c94589f0`, under the shared verify lock, this command ran:

`pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/src/__tests__/object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.test.ts packages/types/src/__tests__/schema-reference-named-list-view-keys-7923.test.ts --reporter=verbose`

It gave `Test Files  2 passed (2)`, `Tests  237 passed (237)` and `os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0`. The pin re-ran verbose at the head `acf69b7835` and gave `Test Files  1 passed (1)`, `Tests  233 passed (233)` and `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The census lines, verbatim:

- `✓ … the census partitions the declaration exactly: 43 read + 21 unread = 64, disjoint and exhaustive`
- `` ✓ … the renderer reads forty-three keys off a named view — every one of them a declared `NamedListView` member — of a declaration with 64, the reason a local key-for-key mirror was never the answer ``
- `✓ … all three instruments read the same declaration, and the two that disagree disagree for a stated reason`. This test asserts the parser at 64, the strict regex equal to it, and the loose regex at 76.
- `✓ … the 21 unread members partition FOUR ways — 0 + 8 + 11 + 2 since objectui#10758 (23 + 8 + 11 + 2 before it) — disjoint and exhaustive`
- `✓ … the protocol declares 50 keys for a named list view, and the instrument that reads them fires`
- `✓ … objectui declares every LIVE protocol key on this surface — the narrower-than-protocol direction is EMPTY today`

This confirms the card's reading: 43 read and 21 unread of 64, with bucket ① empty.

PR objectui#10937 (member 1, `b73e15bf7`) moved no figure:
- `git merge-base --is-ancestor b73e15bf7 HEAD` exits 0, so member 1 is in the base.
- The census test's last commit is `35d68c4ce5` (PR objectui#10884). Member 1 did not touch the test.

The pin's `toBe(64)` dates from `0e2ddd4187` (PR objectui#9534, objectui#8980), per `git log -S`.

The round-0 head `4ee1232a07` also ran `pnpm check:spec-symbols`, `node scripts/check-doc-links.mjs` and `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test`, all exit 0. The last gave ✅ NOT GOVERNED; `.changeset/**` is not a governed surface.

**Tests** ran from the repo root under the shared verify lock at the head `acf69b7835`:
- `Test Files  34 passed (34)`, `Tests  1293 passed (1293)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- The 34 files are every test file that names `.changeset` (33 test files, derived with `git grep -l` over `**/__tests__/**` and `**/*.test.*`, with the one `.md` fixture excluded), plus the `schema-reference-named-list-view-keys-7923` pin.
- `scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs --list` maps `.changeset/**` to `check-changeset-no-major.test.ts` and `dollar-dialect-alias-census.test.ts`. Both are among the 34.

**Not applicable:** package type-check and package test runs. The diff touches no package source, only `.changeset/`.

## Acceptance notes

- **The figures are dated, and they could drift before the release.**
  - For the 7779 note, the PR objectui#10891 seat dropped the figures for this reason (REWORK `5864543090`). This dispatch asked for the figures, so the three notes state them with "at this note's date" and cite the pin.
  - Member 4's five keys are all in the census's read set already. So member 4 is not expected to move the partition (inferred, not measured).
  - If another change moves the census before release PR objectui#5400, these notes go stale.
- **Patch round 1.** The seat folded `.changeset/7947-named-list-view-figures.md` into member 3. It was round 0's first out-of-scope finding, in the same family, and follows the PR objectui#10891 patch-round route. It is one commit, `acf69b7835`, on top of `4ee1232a07`, with no merge, rebase or force-push.
- **Noted, not filed (seat ruling):**
  - `.changeset/8355-retire-calendar-date-aliases.md` has "enforcing 43 unread members", in a paragraph PR objectui#10891's note already supersedes.
  - The failure message of the member-count assertion in `object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.test.ts` still names the "64 declared / 43 unread" figures.
- **The existing 7779 note (an observation, left alone per the ruling).** It says objectui#10758 read "a named view's remaining protocol members". Two protocol members, `pageName` and `tabs`, are declared inert and stay unread. The phrase echoes PR objectui#10884's own title.
- **Commit trailers are model-free** (`Co-authored-by: Claude`), per the dispatch. The trailer the harness offered carries a model name and was not used.
